en.bdb: One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: naarain nij roop dhar naathaa naath sanaath karaiaa|

en.bdb: Narayan, the lord of the destitutes, assuming forms has established mastery over all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: narapat nareh nari(n)dh hai nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: He is the formless king of all men and kings who created various forms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: karataa purakh vakhaaneeaai kaaran karan biradh biradhaiaa|

en.bdb: As is creator of all the causes He is true to His reputation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev dhevaadh dhev alakh abhev na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Gods and goddesses also could not know the extent of that Lord, the imperceptible and beyond all mysteries.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sat roop satinaam kar satigur naanak dheau japaiaa|

en.bdb: The ture Guru Nanak Dev inspired people to remember the true name of the Lord whose form is truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharamasaal karataar pur saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: Founding dharamsala, the place for dharma, at Kartarpur, it was inhabited by the holy congregartion as the abode
Word Wahiguru was imparted (by Guru Nanak) to the people.
